newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian industrial growth to pick up - Chidambaram.
newsitem.headline: Indian industrial growth to pick up - Chidambaram.

text.p: Indian Finance Minister P. Chidambaram said on Thursday that he expected growth of industrial production to pick up in the second half of 1996/97 (April-March).
The government reported on Wednesday that the index of industrial production increased by 9.8 percent in the first six months of 1996/97 compared with the same period in 1995/96.

"The second half by all accounts will be better than the first half and therefore, I am confident that this year, India's economy will do well," Chidambaram told the Confederation of Indian Industry's annual meeting in Calcutta.
Chidambaram said robust growth in agriculture would strengthen the economy in 1996/97.
"This year, agriculture is expected to grow by at least four percent," he said.
